tools.name: generation_model_3d
tools.description: Generate a textured 3D model through ForgeGUI's private provider pipeline. Optional delivery mode publish/roblox additionally publishes the finished model as a Roblox Model asset owned by the selected connection creator (connection_id required for new publish requests; no shared-group fallback); direct or omitted delivery returns file results only and never publishes.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

items.description: An account-owned asset UUID or mcp-artifact reference. Object and style references must resolve to images.

delivery.description: How the finished model is delivered. Omitted or direct returns ForgeGUI file results only. publish/roblox additionally publishes the finished GLB as a Roblox Model asset owned by the explicitly selected connection creator, with connection_id required for new publish requests (legacy requests remain replayable); credentials remain server-only, and published results report a decimal-string asset id once ready.

tools.name: generation_sound_effect
tools.description: Generate game sound effects. Optional delivery publish/roblox requires publication:write and publishes each retained output through the durable Audio publisher. Direct or omitted delivery returns file results and never publishes.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

delivery.description: How finished audio is delivered. Omitted or direct returns ForgeGUI file results only. publish/roblox additionally publishes each retained MP3 output as a Roblox Audio asset owned by the explicitly selected connection creator, with connection_id required for new publish requests (legacy requests remain replayable); credentials remain server-only, and each output reports its own publication status and decimal-string asset id once ready.

tools.name: generation_music
tools.description: Generate game music. Optional delivery publish/roblox requires publication:write and requests below 420 seconds; direct or omitted delivery permits 600 seconds and never publishes. Publication readiness is reported separately per output. loopable requests loop-friendly composition from the provider; no seam validation is performed and a seamless loop is not guaranteed.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

delivery.description: How finished audio is delivered. Omitted or direct returns ForgeGUI file results only. publish/roblox additionally publishes each retained MP3 output as a Roblox Audio asset owned by the explicitly selected connection creator, with connection_id required for new publish requests (legacy requests remain replayable); credentials remain server-only, and each output reports its own publication status and decimal-string asset id once ready.

tools.name: generation_status
tools.description: Read an account-owned durable generation job and artifact result.

tools.name: publication_status
tools.description: Read an account-owned durable Roblox publication by publication_id, including actual asset type, accepted user/group creator and safe connection identity, processing/moderation state, and a decimal-string asset_id only after Roblox supplies one.

tools.name: publication_connections_list
tools.description: List this ForgeGUI account’s Roblox publishing connections, verified creator destinations, eligibility and available asset types. No credentials are returned. Manage connections in ForgeGUI settings. This read does not charge credits.

tools.name: asset_capabilities
tools.description: List the versioned asset preparation, upload, run, and publication routes, their limits and profiles, and whether each is enabled, preview, or unavailable for this account (with a reason). Unavailable routes reject requests before any work. This read does not charge credits.

tools.name: asset_prepare
tools.description: Validate and transform owned sources into an immutable prepared bundle: measured/transformed static GLB models, deterministic image alpha/resize operations, a Roblox skybox from a 2:1 panorama, a tiled PBR texture set, or a standard R15 character outfit. The variant is selected by asset.kind. Returns a durable job_id; poll generation_status for result.prepared_bundle, whose members are reusable mcp-artifact references. Check asset_capabilities first: unavailable or preview-restricted routes are rejected before any work. Preparation does not charge generation credits; at most 3 run at once and 100 per day per account. It never publishes to Roblox.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

model_ref.description: Owned rigid model (GLB) reference used as the accessory Handle.

position.description: Attachment offset in studs, relative to the named R15 attachment.

rotation.description: Normalized quaternion as [x, y, z, w].

animation_bundle_ids.description: Owned prepared animation bundles targeting the same rig profile.

clip_ref.description: Owned provider animation result for that rig.

loop.description: Requested loop behaviour; loop_validation reports whether it was verified.

geometry_ref.description: Owned target mesh whose first UV set the maps are authored for.

source_ref.description: Owned equirectangular panorama with an exact 2:1 aspect ratio.

tools.name: artifact_publish
tools.description: Publish one owned immutable Model GLB, PNG Image, or MP3 Audio artifact to Roblox as a durable job owned by an explicitly selected connection creator; new requests require destination.connection_id. The legacy configured shared-group destination is accepted only for replay of existing requests. Destination credentials are server-only, OAuth is unavailable, no generation is repeated or charged, and group upload does not prove experience access or audible playback. Audio must be under 20,000,000 bytes and 420 seconds, at most 48 kHz, mono/stereo; no transcoding or seamless-loop verification. Returns truthful processing/moderation state and a decimal-string asset_id only when Roblox supplies one.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

artifact_ref.description: Owned Model, Image, or Audio asset reference to publish.

tools.name: run_create
tools.description: Create a private, owner-scoped record of one game build attempt, optionally pinned to an owned style revision and an intended Roblox universe/place (declared context, not verified access). Idempotent by request_id; returns run_id and revision 1.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

style.description: Owned style revision the run intends to use.

tools.name: run_append
tools.description: Append up to 25 typed events to an open run under optimistic concurrency (expected_revision). Job, bundle, and publication links carry only IDs; the server resolves their tool, status, hashes, and creator from the account's own records. External assets and verification are recorded as caller-reported and never upgraded to server-verified. Replaying a committed request_id returns its original receipt even if the run has advanced; a stale revision returns revision_conflict.

request_id.description: Stable caller-chosen idempotency key. Reuse only with identical parameters.

source_url.description: Recorded as reported; the server never fetches it.

items.description: An account-owned asset UUID or mcp-artifact reference. Object and style references must resolve to images.

evidence_refs.description: Owned screenshots or other owned artifacts.

tools.name: run_get
tools.description: Read an owned run summary, its computed evidence summary once closed, and a page of events (use next_cursor for more). Closed runs include each link's frozen at_completion snapshot and manifest {sha256, byte_size}. Set manifest_link to also receive manifest.download_url, valid for 300 seconds: the file is the frozen manifest byte-for-byte, so its SHA-256 equals manifest.sha256. Treat the URL as a secret and do not store it in run records.

manifest_link.description: Also return a short-lived download URL for the closed run's frozen manifest.

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: List owned runs newest first, filtered by style revision, outcome, prepared or published asset kind, creator, intended universe, tag, creation time, or text in name/description/tags. Cursors are bound to the filters that produced them.
